name: Toolbox Economy Curves
author: Oddisz
description: Choose how AoTD Theory of Toolbox scales colony food demand, domestic goods demand, farm output and farm machinery demand with colony size: Theory of Toolbox's doubling, a bend that keeps it up to size 7 and grows gentler above, linear, a gentle curve or your own. Buildings that produce more pay more upkeep. Light Industry (and optionally Heavy Industry) can follow the same curve, and cuts raid loot down to a share of what the colony actually holds. Everything is in the LunaLib settings and works up to colony size 15.
